subject: Geopolitics
title: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
description: A quick win: understand The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation.

hook.text: China and Russia co-lead a security bloc that now includes India, Pakistan, and Iran. The West has no seat.

buildup.text: The SCO was born in 2001 to manage Central Asian security. It expanded into a broader anti-Western counterweight.

discovery.text: Members conduct joint military exercises, share intelligence, and coordinate on counterterrorism across Eurasia.

twist.text: India and China fight on their shared border while sitting in the same alliance. The SCO tolerates internal tension.

climax.text: The SCO's real power is legitimizing non-Western security architecture. It says: we can solve problems without the US.

punchline.text: Not every power club has Western members — or wants them.

quiz.question: What was the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation originally created for?
